english.title: Driver of a taxi fail to leave feeder park when directed and proceed to authorised standing on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the driver of a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to leave the taxi feeder park at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) on Heathrow Airport, by an exit designated for that purpose and in the order in which you had entered, immediately when required to do so by

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY NAME..), a constable,]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY NAME..), an airport official,]_

and proceed directly and without delay to the authorised standing
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9.15 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
